recommendations.quote: Min uppfattning är att, och jag har faktiskt varit aktieägare tidigare, men är inte längre aktieägare för att jag har fått en känsla av att det ska städas och det städas. Men när har ni städat klart? Jag kommer med noggrannhet fortsätta att följa det och lyssnar in nyfiket när ni publicerar nya rapporter.

summary: Interview with Ratos CEO Jonas Wiström discussing the company's strategic shift from private equity model to active long-term ownership. CEO explains they are halfway through a three-year cleanup to fix underperforming portfolio companies, with focus on operational improvements over financial engineering. Major holdings discussed include Plantagen (retail, high debt, new CEO), Aibel (oil services, transitioning to wind), and construction companies.
key_takeaways: Ratos is transitioning from private equity model to active long-term ownership with focus on operational excellence
Company is halfway through three-year cleanup program to improve portfolio profitability
Strategic shift: focus on right leadership and company development rather than financial engineering
Goal: Build portfolio that can generate dividends without needing to sell companies
Plantagen and Aibel are key challenges but showing signs of improvement
